scope: Complete compiled C/H literal/initializer inventory and source-deviation admission decisions; no runtime/parity/packaging acceptance

method.strings: Lexically scan all .c/.h including inactive preprocessing branches; exclude comments/chars; include quoted header names; tokens individually inventoried even if adjacent
method.arrays: All named array explicit initializers, constant aggregate descriptors and known implicit-zero static/global storage arrays. Static/global fields without initializer are type layout, not copied resources.
method.original_matching: Find each decodable Latin1 literal of at least4bytes anywhere in independently admitted unrelocated image. Exact occurrence is an address clue, not semantic/provenance proof.
method.public_payload_policy: No literal text or initialized data copied into evidence; source/image hashes and locators only

candidate_build_admission: Allowed only in private separate writable workspace with MIT notice, exact source provenance, pinned dependency/compiler and declared sample domains. Not a distributable or whole-core admission.
candidate_distribution_admission: REJECTED: original/adapted result and runtime text, identity-marker review, unresolved behavior/caller contracts, missing complete resource and package checks. No resource payload may be published.

representative_native_domain.state: Fixed relocatedDGROUP, supported scalar/data inputs selected independently from original code; explicit source-image and relocation state
representative_native_domain.memory: Stable owned memory, declared nonoverlapping code/state/scratch. Sample accessors may wrap20bits; directDS lvalues remain host little-endian assumptions unless separately repaired.
representative_native_domain.stack: DS=SS only where sample declares it; C value calls do not model original stack byte writes, changed return words or arbitrary aliasing. Raw bus evidence remains authoritative.
representative_native_domain.timing: Serialized deterministic calls, no real device/IRQ/nesting, audio/render transport or physical timing claim
representative_native_domain.comparison: Compare only explicit observable memory/state/output/ports from the chosen original byte routine; register/FLAGS/return cleanup not exported by candidate remain excluded
